correctness.rationale: Reconstructing all twelve grid vertices and independent four-subsets gives 61 forbidden sets, 1415 faces, and f-vector (12,66,220,434,466,217). The specified deterministic matching exhaustively pairs 1394 distinct faces, leaving exactly one 0-cell and twenty 5-cells. A complete topological sort on all 6160 oriented codimension-one incidences verifies acyclicity, so discrete Morse theory proves the integral wedge of twenty 5-spheres. Signed chain traces and the rational Lefschetz identity yield the four reflection character values (20,0,-4,0); C2xC2 character orthogonality gives multiplicities (4,4,6,6). All computations are replayed by verify.py.

value.rationale: This is the first three-row rectangular grid beyond the elementary 3-by-3 parity-only case that has 31 independent four-subsets mixing bipartition colors, and its square-sequence contains necessary corner gluings. It gives a complete integral homotopy classification at the first substantial k=4 unresolved instance of a new 2026 sphere-wedge conjecture, strengthening a known Euler-only width formula; its full rectangular reflection representation supplies additional structural symmetry information useful for equivariant comparisons. No all-width generalization is claimed.
